description: Check the status of async operations. Returns status, result, and timing for one or more operations. Operations remain in memory after completion — call this to retrieve results. This is the companion tool to sendcurrency, which returns an operation ID that must be polled here to get the transaction ID. Without operationids, returns all operations known to the node.

operationids.description: Array of operation IDs to check (e.g., ["opid-f4422247-..."]). Omit to return all operations.

name: z_getoperationstatus
